opening.argument: The title identifies the Apple support call as phony, and the speaker explains that the purpose is to test the service: “I thought it would be cool if we call them up today and figure out just how effective this service can really be.” The AppleCare identity and screen-viewing request are presented within that examined interaction, including the exchange, “AppleCare would like to view your screen. Is that you? Yeah. That's me. Okay. I'm going to go ahead and click Accept.” The available evidence does not establish that viewers are asked to grant access or that information is obtained. The Squarespace sponsorship and requests to like, comment, and subscribe remain separate promotional or audience-engagement content, unrelated to the Apple support interaction.
